expr: (() => { const S=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')]; return S.length===1 && S[0].options.length===32 && S[0].options[0].value==='H2' && S[0].options[31].value==='U238' && !document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]') ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('#sim-root .controls button'); return b && b===document.querySelector('#sim-root .controls').firstElementChild ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).join(',')==='ydin' ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?840:400) ? 1 : 0; })()

expr: (() => { const a=window.simAdapter.get().tilt; const S=document.querySelector('#sim-root select'); S.value='He4'; S.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); const b=window.simAdapter.get().tilt; return a>0 && b>3*a ? 1 : 0 })()
